cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Give It Up
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender something they value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only writing the auction labels. Let me put your medal ahead of the toaster; would you donate it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the only thing I've ever won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll give it a page to itself, with your name. We can start the bidding above the toaster.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I just lend it for the display? I want people to know I won.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have you present it to the buyer. They can hear how you won it before you let it go; I'll keep the microphone with you for that part.
